name: TEP Dashboard
tagline: A dashboard for visualizing Earth-related projects.
description: The TEP Dashboard is a web-based tool designed to provide an overview of various Earth projects, using interactive charts and graphs. It leverages Chart.js for data visualization and includes custom CSS styles for a unique user experience.

page.objective: A dashboard for visualizing Earth-related projects.
page.solution: The TEP Dashboard is a web-based tool designed to provide an overview of various Earth projects, using interactive charts and graphs. It leverages Chart.js for data visualization and includes custom CSS styles for a unique user experience.

highlights.headline: Eight Chart.js visualizations turn project data into one dashboard.
points: Mixes bar, doughnut, and pie charts across a 1,000+ line single file.
Built for project and portfolio-level financial visualization, not just one job.
Runs as a live HTML preview — no server, no build step.
